category: D-RELEASE-1.0 §11 classification of every OPEN issue. Columns: issue, category, reason, owner. The gate scripts/check_release_blockers.sh cross-checks this ledger against the GitHub labels; drift is RED. Categories: 1.0-blocks | 1.0-outside | post-1.0 | not-a-bug | tracking/contract.

reason: Feature — reading text from documents (PDF/`documento.texto`); explicitly OUTSIDE the 0.5.0 scope and the 1.0 core surface, tracked under the official-packages plan (R1/interop-first, experimental). Real issue, accepted after 1.0.

Test/environment defect, not a Kof bug: `NativeCrossDynamicLinkTest#ldArgsSqliteAddsLsqlite3` asserts `-lsqlite3` while the host/CI sysroot ships only the soname `libsqlite3.so.0`, so the impl correctly emits `-l:libsqlite3.so.0` (`NativeCrossLink.sqliteLinkArg`, `423351903`). The assertion must derive from `NativeCrossLink.sqliteLinkArg(...)`; no language/runtime defect.

Real native/riscv64 codegen defect in an EXPERIMENTAL official package (`libs/image` VP8L decode >16384 px aborts `array index out of bounds` under qemu; JVM/x86-64 correct). Subject is outside the 1.0 core surface (`kof.image` is experimental; catalogued as `known-bugs` §544); not a 1.0 blocker.
Missing `kof.ui` `Scroll` layout widget (architecture §2.8 promises it). Subject (the UI widget set) is outside the 1.0 core surface; the UI lane owns the additive widget. Not a 1.0 blocker.

Real cross-backend CORRECTNESS defect on supported targets: on Native riscv64/aarch64 (qemu), a call with 9+ total arguments (records with 8+ fields, methods with 8+ params) silently computes WRONG values — no crash, no diagnostic; JVM/JS/x86-64 are correct (golden). Violates the cross-target parity contract (rule 5) and the D-RELEASE-1.0 exit gate; catalogued as `known-bugs` §546 (distinct from §545 = spawn×extern SIGSEGV). Core semantics, must be closed before the first RC.

Design front `D-SIZE-BUDGET` (Phase 1 = measurement only): a size/observability contract for the KOF distribution; no behaviour or dependency changes, no CI blocking. Not part of the 1.0 core surface; accepted after 1.0 (rule-6 decision request tracked separately).

Real core-semantics defect on supported native targets: a `Map` whose value type is `Bool`/`Double`/`Float` stores the value RAW while the tag-7 read descriptor dereferences it as a magic pointer → `SIGSEGV` rc=139 on every native target (`mapOf("t", true).get("t")` prints nothing; JVM prints `true`). Root cause = a `#259/N2` writer/reader mismatch (`CollectionLoweringSupport.mapBoxablePrim` left at the pre-N2 family `{int,char,short,byte,long}` while `NativeBoxTags.unboxFn` became non-null for bool/double/float). Violates the cross-target parity contract (rule 5) and the `D-RELEASE-1.0` exit gate; catalogued as `known-bugs` §284-map (writer/reader). Core semantics, must close before the first RC.

Feature/tooling request — `kfvm`, a Kof-written Kof version manager (download official releases, verify SHA256SUMS, manage the `~/.local/share/kof/kof-<ver>-<platform>` layout + `current`, Windows junction). New tooling surface, no core language/runtime change; outside the 1.0 core surface, accepted after 1.0 (needs a design/decision, `D-KOF-FIRST` Gate 5 is explicitly N/A for tooling per the report).
